purpose: Reversible structural encoding of repeated cell metadata; source-only, no pruning or question-dependent selection.
canonical_json: UTF8 ensure_ascii=false sort_keys=true separators comma/colon allow_nan=false; reject duplicate keys/nonfinite values. Original text must equal canonical parsed JSON or reject without normalization.

supported_chunks.node: Exactly chunk_id,chunk_type,node_id,text; type=node. Text object with cells:list,header_rows:list. Keep every record field unchanged except cell-list encoding.
supported_chunks.edge: Exactly chunk_id,chunk_type,edge_id,text; type=edge. Keep complete original chunk and text unchanged within wrapper.

node_encoding.cells: record.cells and each header_rows item cells: every cell object must have exactly cell_fields keys; convert to array in declared order, preserving every JSON value/type including null and boolean, order and count. Reject missing/extra keys/nonobjects.
node_encoding.headers: Each header item remains object; encode cells only, retain all other keys/values. Missing/nonlist cells errors.
node_encoding.record: Keep all other record fields including values, dictionary_refs, locations, sha256, nested metadata; no translation or derivation.
node_encoding.structure: Exactly projection_version,raw_chunk_sha256,identity,cell_fields,record. identity contains original chunk fields except text. record is encoded parsed text; cell_fields declared once per chunk.

edge_encoding: Exactly projection_version,raw_chunk_sha256,raw_chunk. raw_chunk deep-copies complete original edge.

integrity.raw_chunk_sha256: Compute SHA256 of canonical entire original chunk including original text; no caller-supplied digest.
integrity.decode: Only declared version and exact wrapper keys. Node exact cell_fields sequence and every array length5; reconstruct dictionaries and canonical text, attach identity. Edge return raw_chunk. Revalidate original contract, recompute digest; mismatch errors, no partial result.
integrity.roundtrip: decode(encode(original)) equals original chunk object exactly, no corpus lookup; no mutation. Raw corpus/manifests unchanged.
integrity.limit: Hash checks representation integrity, not factual truth/authenticated origin; parent validates source-exact chunks.

integration.axis: New representation condition; affects model interface and size, equal comprehension unverified.
integration.arms: Same encoder for all A1/B/C/D/E; retain raw baselines; no embedding/ranking updates.
integration.packing: Count complete compact messages under same caps/max8candidates. Save raw_selected_chunks,compact_selected_chunks and separate hashes. Never substitute compact hash for raw.
integration.downstream: If compact-packed B seeds C/E, downstream candidates also change: integrated representation/selection intervention, not pure size comparison. Fixed-candidate length diagnostic is separate and not efficacy.
integration.C_D: D exact C compact evidence; no extra source lookup/repacking from report. Checker decodes only selected transmitted chunks, not whole corpus, cites original IDs.
integration.checker: Assert decoded chunks equal saved raw selected chunks before unchanged SHACL/Python checks; all fields recoverable, no hidden omitted fields. Preserve unknown/applicability.
integration.scorer: Unchanged source-exact support scorer uses verified decoded raw envelopes offline only; not measure LLM comprehension. No labels in encoding/packing/checker.

validation_plan: Unit cases types/null/bool/formula/cache/empty lists/nested headers, extra/missing keys, invalid version/width/hash tampering/no mutation
All-corpus roundtrip audit for every node/edge; full failures and source hashes
Fixed-candidate fullserialized sizes including wrapper/schema overhead before integrated selection
Fresh independent reviews for implementation/execution; old results/failures preserved
Actual-model tokenizer/chat framing/outputreserve before anyLLM calls; E5diagnostic only
